da-non-sequitur.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] Step 1 is fine (π₁ SU(2) = 0, so the bundle over S² is trivial). E_± are in sl₂(ℂ), not su(2), so the split needs the complexification. Step 3, "A⁰ = X dz = λ_SW", is not derived: it equates the Cartan component of a connection with a Higgs-field eigenvalue, two different objects. The claim that "the spectral curve restricts to a single sheet" over 𝒮_c is unsupported, since the colour cubic is 3-sheeted. "Connection of the mass identity" is physics framing.

Full read of the proof after #8888 commit 794e9a00 (C18). The complexification point is fixed (H, E_pm now in sl_2(C)) and gauge-dependence is stated. The central step is unchanged: "the spectral curve restricts to a single sheet, and the Higgs-field eigenvalue is the color coordinate X. The abelian component therefore satisfies A^0 = X dz" equates the Cartan component of a connection with a Higgs-field eigenvalue without an argument; the single-sheet restriction of the 3-sheeted colour cubic over S_c is asserted. Also A^0 is called U(1)-valued while its coefficient in the sl_2(C) decomposition is complex.
